answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 49404 Country: Pakistan Title: Whether Shark Is Halal or Haram Question: Is shark halal or haram? Is it allowed in Islam? Answer ID: 49404 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1813/1457/B=12/1434) Every kind of fish is halal to eat. If shark is also a fish, then why there is doubt whether it is halal or not? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
